confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Cartagena's Old Town, Getsemaní and Bocagrande pricing, projected to July 2026 with school-holiday demand. No live listings or price pages were checked. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel rates vary widely by season, neighborhood and booking channel. Cocktail and wine were set from the local beer price (cocktail about 3x beer, wine about 2.7x) because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX value comes from search-result summaries of RBA pages (the exchange-rates table and homepage); the pages themselves were not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Anchors combine general knowledge of Colombian Caribbean coastal tourism with a Cartagena premium for Old Town and Bocagrande demand, benchmarked loosely against Medellín for local restaurant prices and Santa Marta for budget lodging. No direct price dataset was consulted.
